css: @page{size:A4 portrait;margin:6mm}.return-note{border:1.2mm solid #111;padding:6mm;color:#111;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}.band{background:#111;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;padding:4mm}.warning{background:#ffd966;border:1px solid #111;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;padding:2mm;margin:3mm 0}.header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 45mm;gap:8mm}.header h2{margin:0 0 2mm}.qr{text-align:center;font-size:8px;font-weight:700}.qr img{width:42mm;height:42mm}.qr small{display:block}.reason,.custody{border:1px solid #333;padding:3mm;margin:3mm 0}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:4mm 0}th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:2mm;font-size:10px}th{background:#eee}.sign{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4mm;margin-top:8mm}.sign>div{border:1px solid #333;min-height:26mm;padding:3mm;font-size:10px}.footer{margin-top:5mm;border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:2mm;text-align:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:700}
